name: HZ_WORK_CLASS
description:
The HZ_WORK_CLASS table stores custom-defined classification information about a person's job title and work experience. 

For example, one system may use classifications such as "Electrician" and "Master" while another may use job codes and seniority indicators such as "EM3" and "over 20" to indicate a class 3 Master Electrician with over 20 years of experience. 

Note that there may be multiple records in the HZ_WORK_CLASS table for each record in the HZ_EMPLOYMENT_HISTORY table.

columns.name: WORK_CLASS_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for this class of work

columns.name: LEVEL_OF_EXPERIENCE
columns.description: User-defined rating for the level of experience in this class of work. For example, journeyman, trainee, or exposure

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: EMPLOYMENT_HISTORY_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the HZ_EMPLOYMENT_HISTORY table

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: WORK_CLASS_NAME
columns.description: User-determined classification for work. For example, bricklayer, doctor, lawer, programmer, or minister of health.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Record status flag

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY_MODULE
columns.description: Identifier for the source application module that created this record

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).
